sections.label: NIEC diploma intake plan
sections.summary: The new National Institute of Early Childhood Development plans to admit about 700 students to its Diploma in Early Childhood Development and Education for Academic Year 2019, double the 2015 intake.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: To attract more post-Secondary students, the newly established National Institute of Early Childhood Development (NIEC) plans to admit about 700 students to their new Diploma in Early Childhood Development and Education programme for Academic Year 2019, which is double the intake in 2015.

sections.label: ECDA senior educator positions
sections.summary: ECDA has been working with Anchor Operators to create 1,000 more senior professional positions for educators by 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: ECDA has also been working with Anchor Operators to enhance the career prospects for their educators by creating 1,000 more senior professional positions by 2022.

sections.label: Early childhood educator salaries
sections.summary: ECDA's 2016 survey shows basic salaries for educarers, teachers and principals, with increases since 2013 outpacing the general market, and higher starting salaries for Diploma fresh graduates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Based on ECDA's 2016 survey, basic salaries for educarers with a professional Certificate range from about $1,800 to $2,100 per month, salaries for teachers with a professional teaching Diploma range from $2,200 to $3,000, and salaries for principals with a professional leadership Diploma range from $3,100 to $6,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: These salaries have increased by about 15% since the previous survey in 2013, outpacing that of the general market for similar job sizes which grew by about 8% over the same period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Also, based on the 2017 Polytechnic Graduate Employment Survey, the starting salaries of full-time early childhood Diploma fresh graduates have increased by about 20% to $2,300 since 2013.

sections.label: Mid-career entrants to preschool sector
sections.summary: Three quarters of those joining the preschool sector as educators are mid-career entrants, one quarter come from Pre-employment Training, and one quarter of mid-career entrants come under Place and Train and PCP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In fact, three quarters of those joining the sector becoming educators in the preschool sector are mid-career entrants, with the remaining one quarter coming from the Pre-employment Training sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: One quarter of those who are mid-career entrants come under the Place and Train and PCP.

sections.label: Factors affecting male preschool teachers
sections.summary: Some senior educators said some parents are uncomfortable with male teachers, such as showering children, and many preschools allow only women to shower children, part of cultural mindset factors being tackled.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: A second belief, believe it or not, some of the senior educators told me that some parents are not comfortable with male teachers, for example, showering children and many preschools across the sector decide to allow only women to shower children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And of course, all these play a part in the cultural mindset.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, a whole range of factors, but as I have given in my comprehensive reply, we are tackling them: cultural mindset, misconceptions, salaries, progression pathways, mid-career pipelines, specialisations, senior positions and pathways that assure people that they can grow in the sector by picking up certain skills.
